servinfo.title: Boost Pressure Sensor with IAT Sensor-2 Inspection

s1.ptxt: Remove boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2.
Check boost pressure sensor output voltage as follows.
If faulty condition is found, replace boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2.

s2.ptxt: Arrange 3 new 1.5 V batteries (1) in series, and check total voltage is 4.5 to 5.0 V.
Connect voltmeter (2), special tool and batteries to boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2 (3) as shown in figure and set the tool in “VACUUM” mode.

attention3.ptxt: Before using special tool (vacuum pump gauge), read its Operator’s Manual to know how to use it.

s2.ptxt: Check voltage varies gradually when negative pressure is gradually applied with special tool.

attention3.ptxt: Environmental condition affects output voltage largely.
The sensor voltage below is reference value when measuring under the following conditions.

item.ptxt: Atmospheric pressure: 101.3 kPa (1.0 kgf/cm2, 14.7 psi, 1.01 bar)

spec.title: Boost pressure sensor reference voltage
spec.ptxt: Negative pressure –30 kPa (–0.3 kgf/cm2, –4.4 psi, –0.3 bar): Approx. 1.30 V
Negative pressure –60 kPa (–0.6 kgf/cm2, –8.7 psi, –0.6 bar): Approx.0.86 V

s1.ptxt: Remove boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2.

Check that resistance between sensor terminals varies depending on temperature while blowing hot air to temperature sensing part of boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2 (1) using hot air drier (2).
If faulty condition is found, replace boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2.
